cases.citation: NASA EOL ISS045-E-168055, opened as the saved page and at the URL above. Photo time 21:49:09 GMT. The caption says the frame is 4 min 12 s after launch, so liftoff is 21:44:57Z. Nadir 45.2 N, 48.2 W. Altitude 404 km. Sun elevation -24 degrees. Focal length 1150 mm.

NASA EOL ISS060-E-80405, opened 2026-10-06. Photo 2019-09-25 14:02:09 GMT. Nadir 51.6 N, 91.9 E. Altitude 404 km. Sun elevation -21 degrees. Focal length 170 mm. The EOL caption is empty. The NASA images record iss060e080405 names this frame as Christina Koch's photo of Soyuz MS-15 ascending from Kazakhstan. Liftoff 13:57:42 UTC is the Wikipedia Soyuz MS-15 infobox, not the EOL page.
cases.note: EOL does not name the pad.

No opened EOL page names the 2020-10-14 launch. A date search for ISS063 on that day returned uncataloged frames and no launch caption. NASA images iss063e107170 is the docking approach over Morocco, so it is not this case.
No opened EOL page names the 2022-09-21 launch. ISS067 frames that afternoon are uncataloged and have no launch caption.

cases.citation: NASA EOL ISS072-E-220043, opened 2026-10-06. Photo 2024-11-19 22:03:28 GMT. Nadir 26.9 N, 102.9 W. Altitude 419 km. Sun elevation 22 degrees. Focal length 200 mm. The EOL caption is empty. The NASA images record iss072e220043 titles this frame as the Starship 6 launch plume from Starbase, Boca Chica, seen from the station.
cases.note: The EOL page does not state liftoff time.
No opened EOL page names the 2025-01-16 launch. ISS072 frames that day have no New Glenn caption, and the NASA images library returned no matching frame.
